title: Fix Ingredient List Realtime Hub Routing
description: Resolve cross-service SignalR connectivity so ingredient list detail pages can open and edit with realtime synchronization in Aspire by routing hub connections to apiservice and propagating user identity for hub authorization.

tasks.title: Route web SignalR client to apiservice hub and authorize via X-User-Id
acceptance_criteria: IngredientListSignalRClient resolves an apiservice base URL from service discovery configuration and connects to /hubs/ingredient-list on that service
IngredientListSignalRClient sends the signed-in user id as X-User-Id during hub connection setup
IngredientListHub resolves user id from claims or X-User-Id header for server-to-server hub calls
IngredientListHubTests include coverage for header-based user-id resolution
ApiService and Web projects build successfully after the change
tasks.notes: SignalR client now resolves the apiservice base URL from configuration, connects to /hubs/ingredient-list on apiservice, and forwards X-User-Id from auth claims. IngredientListHub now resolves identity from claims or X-User-Id header. Added hub test coverage for header-based identity fallback. Evaluator verdict: PASS.

dependencies: Requires AppHost service reference from webfrontend to apiservice (already configured)
Requires existing ingredient list hub endpoint mapping in ApiService
